summary: iter224 (PIN editor_name audit, QR labels PDF, AI-suggest packing, drag-drop floor plan, edit-token payload w/ legacy compat) fully validated. 15/15 new backend pytest cases pass; 18/18 iter223 regression clean. Frontend admin panel exposes all 4 new testids (ship-add-packing-unit, ship-ai-suggest-packing, ship-print-labels, floor-plan-svg). Donor page editor-login dialog correctly requires name≥2 AND PIN, and unlocks edit mode with a 'Welcome TEST_Sarah UI — session unlocked 12h' toast confirming editor_name propagates through the HMAC token.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /shipments/{sid}/packing-units/{uid} does NOT clamp floor_x_cm / floor_y_cm to container bounds (L−unit.L_cm, W−unit.W_cm). A drag beyond container walls will persist an out-of-range coordinate; FE currently clamps visually but nothing enforces server-side. Recommend adding a clamp in update_packing_unit when floor_x_cm/floor_y_cm keys are present, using container_dims_cm from the parent shipment.

apply_suggested_packing shelf-packs but never checks if resulting row height exceeds container width; a very long list of proposals could push units past the container. Low priority — AI is capped at 20 units.
shipments.py is now 2719 lines (grew from 2520 → +199 in iter224). The suggestion to split into shipments/{core,packing,airport,tracking,ai,labels}.py is now firmly overdue.

shipment_labels_pdf loads weasyprint lazily inside the request body — first call in a fresh worker is ~1–2s slower than subsequent calls. Consider hoisting the import (or accept the trade-off for cold-start memory).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 primary testids present, PIN dialog gating verified, editor_name toast confirmed)

seed_data_creation: Test shipments prefixed TEST_iter224_* created + deleted per test class; one UI shipment sh_060a2b69b3 created and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter224 endpoints live: POST /api/shipments/{sid}/ai-suggest-packing (Gemini 3 Flash), POST /api/shipments/{sid}/apply-suggested-packing, GET /api/shipments/{sid}/labels.pdf, POST /api/public/shipments/{token}/login now requires editor_name. Edit-token payload is 4-part (shipment|editor|expires|sig); legacy 3-part still verifies with editor_name=''. Donor ShipmentDonorPage editor login dialog has ship-donor-editor-name input + ship-donor-pin-input + ship-donor-pin-submit (disabled until name≥2 AND PIN present).
